pages.title: File:New Jubilee Bridge.jpg

ObjectName.value: New Jubilee Bridge

Categories.value: Jubilee Bridge (India)|Sampreeti Bridge|Self-published work

ImageDescription.value: The East Indian Rail traffic were diverted through New Jubilee bridge between Bandel and Naihati section of Eastern Railway. The old Jubilee bridge served the people for 129 years and several generations used the service to connect across the River Hooghly. Also, The old Jubilee Bridge has credit of being first permanent crossing over Hooghly which was considered unbridgeable owing to difficult foundation condition at that time.
